description: Compose ASCII animations: combine any art with a motion. Motions: bounce, shake, blink, slide, reveal, fade, pulse, rain, progress, wave, jump, talk. Returns a bash script or raw frames.

art.description: Art ID (e.g. "heart", "cat", "trophy") or custom ASCII text

output.description: "script" = bash script for terminal. "frames" = raw frame data.

name: animate
